related_work.work_intent_alignment_status: the persisted WorkIntent predates the current environmental capability campaign objective
related_work.campaign_objective: Improve MNCS's ability to understand and improve how effectively its language, compiler, tooling, and environment serve and potentiate agents. Preserve provenance between environmental limitations, implementation, verification, and later observations.

observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment Session.invoke and environmental-capability session-activity projection

outcome.implementation_change: The Environment carries the initial bounded checkout observation through eligibility evidence. After acquiring the selected checkout's operation-scoped lock, it runs fresh eligibility again and compares checkout identity, branch, branch status, committed HEAD, and HEAD availability. A changed value emits effect.operation-deferred with both preflight event references and the changed fields, starts no provider, and records no capability invocation. The existing ECI session-activity projection validates and exposes these stale-state deferrals in both normal and compact output. Compatible separate uncommitted outputs remain serializable without a persistent claim; clean/dirty status alone is intentionally ignored.
outcome.verified_change: The controlled regression changed HEAD between the initial and locked checks and observed a stale-state deferral before provider invocation. The same test retained successful serialized writes to separate paths through two unassigned session objects. All 128 capability-intelligence tests, the selected-worktree session test, and git diff --check passed.
outcome.interpretation_limit: The test verifies a deliberate state-change scenario, not an independently observed agent race. Environment's advisory lock does not fence shell/Git changes outside its operation path. Same-path edits inside an already-dirty checkout remain unresolved. No reduction in live authorization interactions or coordination overhead has been measured.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Selected-checkout state can change between eligibility and provider effect
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: MNCS Environment selected-worktree provider effect preflight
pressure_hypothesis.basis: The implementation addresses a controlled race scenario and retains explicit uncertainty about operational recurrence.
pressure_hypothesis.recurrence: one controlled test scenario; live operational recurrence not established
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Retain both preflight event references and defer when bounded checkout identity, branch, or committed HEAD changes.

improvement_relation.basis: A targeted Environment regression exercised an intervening committed HEAD change and verified that the selected checkout operation is deferred before its provider runs; ECI regression coverage verifies that both preflight references and changed fields remain inspectable.

not_measured: actual production provider behavior during a live race
